name: Anysphere (Cursor)
summary: AI-native coding environment built around the Cursor editor.
overview: Anysphere develops Cursor, an AI-assisted code editor for software teams.
bull_case: A deeply integrated coding agent can become a daily workflow with strong retention.
bear_case: Platform owners and rival coding agents may erode differentiation quickly.

intelligence.description: Anysphere built Cursor, an AI-assisted code editor for software engineers.
company: Anysphere developed Cursor, an AI-assisted code editor integrated into the software-development workflow.
SpaceX acquired Anysphere in a transaction reported at $60 billion in 2026, so this is an acquisition profile rather than a live private valuation profile.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Cursor was a defining company in AI-assisted software development. Its acquisition highlights the strategic value of developer distribution to major AI and infrastructure platforms.

changed.text: SpaceX completed its acquisition of Anysphere; Cursor became a SpaceX subsidiary.

takeaways: Cursor helped define AI-assisted software development.
Anysphere is no longer an independent private-market company.
The acquisition highlights the value of developer distribution.
